The report now flags an item as `REORDER` when what's on hand is less than 6 days of average sales. I ran it against your current `inventory.csv`:

```
SKU      ITEM                       ON HAND  STATUS
CF-1K    House blend 1kg                  9  REORDER
CF-250   Colombia beans 250g             42  ok
FL-100   Paper filters x100               0  OUT
MG-12    Enamel mug                      18  ok
OT-1L    Oat milk 1L                     30  REORDER
TE-50    Breakfast tea x50               25  ok
```

House blend has about 3.75 days of stock left and oat milk about 4, so both are already inside the delivery window.

The 6 is `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` near the top of `stock_report.py`, just under the imports. `OUT` still shows for anything at zero.

An item with exactly 6 days of stock left is not flagged, since it just lasts until delivery. Because the report runs nightly, that item gets flagged the next night with 5 days left, and the shelf sits empty for about a day. Setting `LEAD_TIME_DAYS` to 7 would cover that gap.
